title: SERVICE (The Sixth Discipline)
style:

electronic soul, warm purposeful male vocal NZ/AU accent, deep bass, communal feeling, builds from individual to collective, sense of something larger than self, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 94 BPM

lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
Seva in the temple — give without return
Zakat — the fifth pillar — what you earn you earn
Ubuntu — the village carries what one cannot
Whakapapa — your ancestors are all you've got

[CHORUS]
Service is the discipline
The oldest currency
What you give — comes back
Not to you — through you
Giving is the layer
That builds what money can't
Service is the transformation
From enough — to can't

[OUTRO]
Give first.
Before you need to.
The return is not the point.
```
